programs.title: Karam Yudh
programs.desc: An honest and diligent police officer is killed and wife, Geeta, ensures that their son Vijay avenges his death. Embroiled in a web of treachery and politics, can Vijay accomplish his goal.

programs.title: Kohram
programs.desc: Major Balbir (Amitabh Bachchan) attempts to kill the Indian Home Minister Veer Bhadra Singh (Danny Denzongpa) but is unsuccessful. He has been identified, and the army is on the look-out for him to court-martial him.

programs.title: Jal Mahal
programs.desc: Ravi rescues a girl from suicide and falls in love with her, but his father forbids their relationship. Later, she commits suicide, pushing Ravi into depression.

programs.title: Doodh Ka Karz
programs.desc: Sapheran Parvati, along with her newborn son, Suraj, watches helplessly as her husband, Gangu, is wrongly accused of theft, and then beaten to death. Parvati is all set to avenge Gangu's death.

programs.title: Bandhan
programs.desc: A wastrel father and his righteous son have a showdown and the son is charged with his father's murder. Court-room drama follows as friends and family aren't sure whom to believe and testify for.

programs.title: Gair
programs.desc: An abandoned child raised by a wealthy household takes over the family business. However, he is resented by their natural son who, fueled by a bitter uncle, tries his best to make him lose face.
